name: AllowLatch
description: SERV Policy Copilot + spending turnstile for financial AI agents on Base (USDC). Always-on Vercel /api/gate with native x402 ($0.025). Required: createGatedAgentKit({ kind: site }). assertSpend is advisory. OpenServ optional fallback.

openserv.evaluatePack: buy_evaluate_pack — each paid $0.025 x402 mints fixed credits (default 3); client cannot choose amount
openserv.invoke: x402 payWorkflow with { prompt } - no end-user API keys; users never run the host
openserv.failClosed: timeout / network / malformed → DENY; check gate.isActive but still fail-closed on hang
openserv.note: Use when site gate fails or ALLOWLATCH_PREFER_OPENSERV=1. Host keep-alive required.

websiteGate.evaluatePack: buy_pack — each paid $0.025 x402 mints fixed credits (default 3); evaluate with packKey (~$0.008/check). Requires Turso durable.
websiteGate.sessionSeal: HMAC blob returned on apply/evaluate — client must send it back to survive Vercel cold starts
websiteGate.note: Primary always-on path. Website Origin free; agents pay $0.025 USDC x402 on Base (or burn packKey credits). Required: createGatedAgentKit({ kind: site, gateUrl, sessionSeal, walletPrivateKey, packKey? }). assertSpend is advisory. OpenServ is optional fallback.

skills.description: SERV: draft MandatePolicy with conflicts, assumptions, questions (Multipath, prompt_guard, shadow).
SERV: revise policy from owner feedback.
Persist MandatePolicy. First apply returns ownerToken (required for later mutates).
SERV: compile NL mandate into MandatePolicy JSON and store (requires ownerId / ownerToken).
Optional: mirror daily USDC cap into Coinbase Spend Permissions (requires ownerToken). Site gate also exposes sync_wallet / hybrid_plan / hybrid_report.
Site gate: AgentKit path — createSpendPermission plan (funded SA → AgentKit wallet) + key invariant.
Site gate: operator-advanced host sync_wallet (ownerToken + funded SA + AgentKit address).
Site gate: AgentKit agent reports Spend Permission status after creating permission via CDP.
Deterministic allow | deny | escalate. Issues single-use allow-receipt on ALLOW. Site escalate clears with humanApproved+ownerToken. No transaction.
Site gate: settle allow-receipt jti (free with valid receipt). createGatedAgentKit({ kind: site }) calls this before returning the receipt.
Site gate: paid x402 mints fixed evaluate credits for packKey (Turso durable; client cannot choose amount).
OpenServ fallback: paid x402 mints fixed evaluate credits for packKey (same economics as site buy_pack).
SERV: explain a gate result; never overrides the verdict.
Re-evaluate, consume allow-receipt (jti), then AgentKit USDC transfer only on ALLOW (or escalate + humanApproved + ownerToken).
Audit events for a policyId (ownerToken) or global (operatorToken).
Reset day/hour windows only — lifetime budget preserved. Requires ownerToken.

invariants: Allow/deny/escalate is deterministic code - never LLM judgment
Execute requires verified single-use allow-receipt (or escalate + humanApproved + ownerToken); site kit consumes jti before external sign
Fail-closed: timeout, network error, malformed decision, or missing receipt → DENY
Receipt binds chain, action digest, and calldataHash for swaps; prefer tokenAddress over symbol
Tenant mutates require ownerToken (minted on first apply) or ALLOWLATCH_OPERATOR_TOKEN
Lifetime budget is not reset by public APIs; reset_daily_ledger clears day/hour only
End users never run npm run dev or set SERV_API_KEY — they connect via /api/gate Connect pack; agents must use createGatedAgentKit({ kind: "site" }); assertSpend alone is advisory

AllowLatch does not custody user funds or private keys (hosted gate = SaaS authorization; AgentKit turnstile — Copy for my AI primary; hybrid_plan ceiling optional; funded treasury key in the agent defeats the ceiling; no MetaMask Connect on site)
End users do not configure SERV_API_KEY or CDP - the host operator does; x402 pays the call
